metadata.description: IPCC 2019 Refinement Vol 5 First-Order-Decay (FOD) Landfill Model & Net Anaerobic Digestion Balance

landfill_fod_model.formula: DOC * DOCf * F * (16/12) * MCF * (1 - OX) * GWP_CH4

DOC.description: Degradable Organic Carbon in wet industrial food/organic waste

DOCf.description: Fraction of DOC that actually degrades anaerobically

F.description: Fraction of methane in generated landfill gas

MCF.description: Methane Correction Factor for unmanaged deep dumpsites (>5m)

OX.description: Oxidation factor for unmanaged Indian dumpsites

anaerobic_digestion_model.formula: Net = Avoided Landfill Methane + Displaced Fossil Fuel - Fugitive & Parasitic Emissions
